---
title: "Review allergy changes"
subtitle: "SOP MGR-07 · Manager manual"
---

## Purpose

Review every allergy that was taken off a dog or made less severe, since
these changes leave the dog less protected.

## Applies to

Managers only.

## Before you begin

- Admin is open. See [MGR-02 Open Admin](opening-admin.qmd).

## Procedure

1. On the Admin overview, click **Allergy changes to review**. The list
   opens, one line per change, with the dog, what changed, the reason given
   and who made the change.
2. Read the reason. If you need to see the dog's allergies, click the dog's
   name to open its card.
3. If the change was right, click **Mark reviewed**.

   If the change was wrong, open the dog's card and put the allergy back. See
   [GRM-07 Record a dog's allergies](../groomer/allergies.qmd). Then click
   **Mark reviewed**.

## Result

The change leaves the **Allergy changes to review** list.
